source_refs.note: Exercise 10.1, Question 1: book page 278 (Q1-Q24). The book prints no answers for Exercise 10.1.

blocks.prompt: 1 Solve the following trigonometric equation: \(\sin x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\)
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke sawal kis qisam ka hai: yeh pehle se hi basic equation hai, \(\sin x = k\) wali, jahan \(k = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) positive hai.
Diya kya hai? Sine ki value.
Find kya karna hai? \([0, 2\pi]\) mein principal solutions aur phir general solution.
Rule: reference angle table se, quadrant sine ke sign se, aur aakhir mein period \(2\pi\).
Plan: \(\alpha\) nikalo, do quadrants chuno, do angles likho, \(2n\pi\) jama karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\).
Maloom karna: principal solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: 10.1 wale chaar qadam: reference angle, quadrants, principal solutions, period. Equation pehle se basic hai, is liye koi identity lagane ki zaroorat nahin.

Reference angle
\[\sin\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
\[\alpha = \dfrac{\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: standard values ka table yaad kijiye: \(\sin\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) (yani \(45^{\circ}\)). Reference angle hamesha acute aur positive hota hai.

Quadrants
Sine positive hai, is liye \(x\) quadrant I ya II mein hai.
Kyun: unit circle par sine y-coordinate hai, jo upar wale aadhe hisse (quadrant I aur II) mein positive hota hai.

Principal solutions
\[x = \dfrac{\pi}{4}\]
\[x = \pi - \dfrac{\pi}{4} = \dfrac{3\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: quadrant I mein angle khud \(\alpha\) hai; quadrant II mein \(\pi\) tak pohanchne se \(\alpha\) pehle ruk jate hain, yani \(\pi - \alpha\).
Dhyan dein: sirf \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) likh kar ruk jana aam ghalti hai; doosra jawab \(\frac{3\pi}{4}\) bhi utna hi zaroori hai.

General solution
\(\sin x\) ka period \(2\pi\) hai:
\[\left\{\dfrac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{3\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\},\ n \in \mathbb{Z}\]
Kyun: har poora chakkar (\(2\pi\)) laga kar hum circle ke usi point par wapas aate hain, is liye sine ki value wahi rehti hai. \(n\) koi bhi integer ho sakta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\sin\dfrac{3\pi}{4} = \sin\left(\pi - \dfrac{\pi}{4}\right)\]
\[= \sin\dfrac{\pi}{4} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: \(\sin(\pi - \theta) = \sin\theta\) wali identity se doosra jawab bhi sahi nikla; pehla jawab to seedha table se hi sahi hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 10.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Kitab ke examples ki tarah hum principal solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein aur general solution sets ke union ki shakal mein dete hain. Aap apna kaam yahan wale hal se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
